daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Volatility Ranking with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, calculate the 30-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns for each stock using window functions. Rank stocks by volatility within each month using ROW_NUMBER(). Then use a CTE to identify the top 5 most volatile stocks for each month in the dataset. Expected output: month, rank, stock_symbol, volatility_score, with stocks sorted by volatility descending within each month.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Risk Score Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (contains crash records with location, severity, vehicles involved). Clean the dataset: handle missing values in severity columns, standardise location formats, remove duplicate crash records. Create a new column 'crash_risk_score' by normalising severity level (1-5 scale) and weighting by number of vehicles involved. Export cleaned data to CSV with the risk score. Expected output: cleaned CSV with at least 500 records, no nulls in key columns, risk_score column with values 0-100.

daily_quests.title: Weather-Driven Energy Demand Correlation Analysis
daily_quests.description: Task Part 1 (Python): Download Australian Weather observations (temperature, humidity, rainfall) and AEMO electricity demand data. Clean both datasets, align by date and state/region, resample to daily averages. Part 2 (SQL): Load cleaned data into SQLite. Write a query using window functions (LAG, LEAD) to calculate the correlation between temperature changes and peak demand changes for each state. Use a CTE to rank states by strength of correlation. Expected output: SQL result showing top 5 states with strongest weather-demand correlation, including correlation coefficient, average lag period, and trend direction (positive/negative).
